steps.text: Your disc images must be converted with the release's own installer. Download the GT2 zip from GitHub, extract it and run INSTALL-QUEST.bat. Select your Gran Turismo 2 BIN disc image when asked. It extracts the game data and copies it to the headset.
Open Gran Turismo 2 VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: INSTALL-QUEST.bat extracts the BIN/CUE discs into Android/data/io.github.gt2pc.quest/files; the extraction is not documented, so qgp cannot do it. Uncertain: the guide (v0.8.1) has the APK only inside the release zip under native/; v0.9.2 publishes GT2-VR-0.9.2.apk on its own, which this recipe uses. v0.9.0 and v0.9.1 had only the zip; if a later release drops the separate APK, switch to the zip with inZip. The release also has many non-Quest builds.
